interpretation: Results are based on two controlled malware benchmark datasets and may not generalize to other domains or continuously evolving datasets.
The experiments cover seven specified poisoning mechanisms; unknown or adaptive attacks remain outside the evaluated attack space.
The controlled poisoning rates are experimental conditions and should not be interpreted as estimates of real-world poisoning prevalence.
The study does not constitute validation in a live production training-data pipeline.
An attacker aware of the anomaly detector could attempt to construct low-anomaly poisoning.
